name: @d2-tools/desktop
description: Windows desktop app for d2-tools, a Chinese Destiny 2 companion.
author: zhangqi

scripts.build: pnpm clean && pnpm --filter @d2-tools/core build && pnpm --filter @d2-tools/http build && pnpm --filter @d2-tools/services build && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
